[size=4][font=Arial]CP version[/font][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Arial]You’ll need to download the latest versions of [b]SMAPI[/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]Download this mod and extract it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]To obtain the furniture in-game : use either the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b] or  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner [/url].[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]﻿Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ makes it even easier to get the furniture and redecorate![/font][/*]
[*]Search for  「[b]CCF[/b]」 to display all furniture items.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]AT version[/size]
[list]
[*]You’ll need to download the latest versions of [b]SMAPI[/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿. [/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder. [/*]
[*]Use the Paint Bucket tool in-game.
Please refer to the image for the list of compatible furniture. [/*]
[*][color=#dbb0a7]! Some furniture items have different specifications from the CP version. In particular, since there is no matching vanilla item for the Flower Lamp, it is placed on an end table. [/color][/*]
[/list]
